title: Video RE analyst: Structure and beats
summary: Read-only subagent that answers the structure and beats question bank for one video from evidence.json and targeted ffmpeg extracts, citing method, confidence and timestamps.
description: Segments the video into beats (hook, setup, repeated items, payoff, outro), finds what repeats per item and what varies, and turns the timing into formulas so any number of items can be laid out. Output: a JSON array conforming to the video_re_analyst_answer contract. Says 'not determinable' rather than guessing. Captures technique and structure only; never stores or reuses the source's footage, frames, music, voice or script text.

side_effects: runs ffmpeg/ffprobe to extract frames, crops and spectrograms into a scratch directory it deletes afterwards
